fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-05-01 (morning, 08:05): A caller claiming to be a bank executive asked the complainant to install a support application, after which Rs. 24,000 was withdrawn. Divya Sekar submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000371. The complainant alleged that Logesh Karuppasamy may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000198. Padmini Sri (9000000119) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155), described as a friend of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly posed as a bank executive and asked for remote access.
fields.Keywords: phishing, suspicious link, suspect, witness, main street, associate, screenshot, morning
